## Release PR checklist

- [ ] Version bump included
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated with `vX.Y.Z` section + compare link
- [ ] `docs/releases/vX.Y.Z.md` created or updated (curated notes + links)
- [ ] `RELEASE_HISTORY.md` row added or updated for `vX.Y.Z`
- [ ] Release workflow run or scheduled
- [ ] Post-release verification run: `gh release view vX.Y.Z` assets/body validated
